text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That was so close~! Just one step away, it 
felt like!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Could it be... was Trainer just hungry?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that's it! When your tummy's 
empty, you can't bring out your true 
strength!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna bake cookies when we get back, 
so let's eat them together! Right, 
Trainer-san?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
